front: Khái niệm 'Impersonal Passive (Bị động khách quan)' trong Unit 5: Wonders of Viet Nam & Natural Beauty được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Used with reporting verbs (say, believe, think, report, claim): It is + past participle + that + clause.

💡 Ví dụ: It is believed that Ha Long Bay was formed over millions of years by geological movements.
🌱 Bản chất: Expresses general public opinions without specifying who holds the belief.

front: Khái niệm 'Suggestions with 'Suggest'' trong Unit 5: Wonders of Viet Nam & Natural Beauty được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Suggest + V-ing OR Suggest that + Subject + (should) + bare infinitive.

💡 Ví dụ: The tour guide suggested that we visit Trang An eco-tourism complex early in the morning.
🌱 Bản chất: The subjunctive bare infinitive is used regardless of the subject (he, she, they).

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Two forms of Impersonal Passive transformation'?
back:
People say that S + V -> 1) It is said that S + V. 2) S + is/are said + to-V (hoặc to have P2 nếu xảy ra trước).

📝 Ví dụ: People believe that Son Doong Cave is the largest cave in the world -> Son Doong Cave is believed to be the largest cave in the world.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Frequently tested transformation pattern in Grade 10 English exams.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Rewrite using impersonal passive: 'People report that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Bước 1: Sử dụng cấu trúc: It is reported that...
Bước 2: Giữ nguyên mệnh đề sau that: 'thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.'
Bước 3: Viết câu hoàn chỉnh: 'It is reported that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.'

👉 Kết luận: It is reported that thousands of foreign tourists visit Hoi An Ancient Town every week.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Writing 'suggest someone to do something': 'She suggested me to go there.'?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Writing 'suggest someone to do something': 'She suggested me to go there.'

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: 'Suggest' never takes an object + to-infinitive. Correct: 'She suggested that I should go there' or 'She suggested going there.'
